body_markdown: Congratulations to Sono-Tek’s new Executive Director, Sales and Business – Brian Booth. Brian has many years of experience as a Regional Sales Manager and Electronics and Advanced Energy Business Unit Director. Brian began his career at Sono-Tek in our Service department in 2007, and joined Sono-Tek’s Sales department in 2010. In addition to overseeing territorial sales managers in his new role, Brian will be guiding business opportunities for sales. This promotion is well earned, and Sono-Tek’s global Sales team will thrive under this new leadership.
